entities.name: Vincenzo Maria Farano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincenzo Maria Farano was an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who worked in the diplomatic service of the Holy See and served as an Apostolic Nuncio to Indonesia and Ecuador before spending more than a decade as Archbishop of Gaeta.
